rationale.sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: LOW -> occupancy limits latency hiding, so shrink block size or register/shared-memory footprint and enlarge the grid (split rows/columns or multiple rows per block) / HIGH -> enough warps already exist, so stop tuning launch config and instead shorten per-warp dependency chains and redundant instruction work
